Document any intentional divergence from Python on invalid input. Preserve all offer terms, disclosures, intake, hashes/authenticity caveats and expiry obligations. Save/read executed results, minimal diff and new exact-digest independent-review handoff. No deployment, contact, spending or new inventory. Complete with actual lease, evidence and lesson. December 7 removal covers listing, both offers, calendar and preview datalist; January 8 retirement includes preview.html.

description: A targeted execution found a concrete preview defect: invalid dates silently become valid-looking UTC deadlines with no warning. This changes the next step to a bounded correction before release. Existing 33/33 parity and 15/15 UI checks remain valid within their tested scope. Feedback remains uncertain: five sources are unclassified; funding and revenue are unverified.
